assumptions: The user wants a general view of sponsor-drug relationships for diabetes trials.
No specific drug names or sponsors were mentioned, so all relevant trials for diabetes are included.
notes: 35,183 studies match on ClinicalTrials.gov, but the fetch stopped at the configured cap of 5,000 studies per search term; counts reflect that sample, not the full registry.
Network pruned to the 15 most connected entities per group and the 56 strongest edges; edge weight is the number of studies in which the two entities co-occur.

meta.query: Show a network of sponsors and drugs for diabetes trials

plan.interpretation: Display a network graph showing connections between sponsors and drugs studied in clinical trials for diabetes.
